products.name: Abstract Thoughts
products.wood: Oak, Walnut, Cherry, Purple Heart, Bloodwood, and Mahogany
products.description: We know rolling can get messy. This custom rolling tray keeps everything organized with two cutouts for your jar or grinder, plus dedicated spots for your lighter, cones, and papers. The chaos pattern helped to bring out our abstract thoughts!

products.name: Bob and Weave
products.description: Bob and Weave combines bold geometry with classic craftsmanship. The woven end grain pattern gives this cutting board a striking look while providing a durable surface built for everyday use. Complete with a built in juice groove, it’s designed to perform beautifully while standing out on your countertop.

products.name: Froggy Fresh
products.description: Froggy Fresh brings together natural movement and bold character in a one of a kind design. Crafted from Black Limba, the repeating stacked pattern highlights the wood’s unique grain while creating a durable cutting surface built for everyday use. Finished with a built in juice groove, this board is made to stand out in any kitchen.

products.name: The Hollow Eye
products.description: The Hollow Eye blends bold symmetry with the natural contrast of Zebra Wood and walnut. Its repeating stacked pattern creates a striking visual design while providing a durable cutting surface built for everyday use. A functional piece that stands out whether in use or on display.

products.name: The Heirloom
products.description: The Heirloom is a handcrafted valet box made from rich sapele mahogany and finished in shellac. The upper display compartment is perfect for glasses and everyday essentials, while the pull out drawer adds extra storage below. Built with timeless craftsmanship, it’s designed to be both functional and lasting.

products.name: Slippery Walnut
products.description: Crafted with a walnut body and maple slide top, this handcrafted box combines clean design with everyday function. Its smooth sliding lid and timeless wood contrast make it perfect for storing keepsakes, accessories, or daily essentials.

products.name: Zebra
products.description: Crafted from striking zebrawood, this handcrafted charcuterie board highlights the natural contrast and flowing grain unique to the species. Its sleek profile and handle design make it perfect for serving cheeses, meats, and appetizers with a clean, timeless presentation.

products.name: Zebra's and Cigar's
products.description: Crafted from bold zebrawood in an end grain pattern, Zebra & Cigars is a handcrafted cigar ashtray designed to stand out. The rich contrast and layered grain create a striking centerpiece, while the deep rests and solid construction make it perfect for slow evenings and good conversation.
